avg(x, ms) mean over the last ms milliseconds
between(x, lo, hi): 1 when lo <= x <= hi
bit(x, n): bit n of x, 0 = least significant
coalesce(a, b, ...) first argument that has a value
delta(x) change since the previous sample
ema(x, ms) low-pass filter, time constant ms
held(cond, ms) 1 once cond has been true for ms
maxw(x, ms) largest value in the last ms
median(x, n) median of the last n samples
minw(x, ms) smallest value in the last ms
prev(x[, n]) value n samples ago, same as [x-n]
rate(x) change per second since the previous sample
slope(x, ms) rate of change per second over the last ms
smooth(x, n) mean of the last n samples
stdev(x, ms) standard deviation over the last ms
table(x, x0, y0, x1, y1, ...) straight lines between points
thermistor(x, a, b, c[, full]) Steinhart-Hart on an ADC count
time() seconds since the start of the session or log
valid(x) 1 when x has a value right now, else 0
